name: Kanemori Kyou
source:
St. Ao Academy School Doctor.

[url=/c47193]Aoi's[/url] older brother, he's always worried about him.
A kind person who always interacts softly with others, and doesn't like violence and fighting.
He has a weak body and sometimes he will show a pained expression on his face.
